collision_energy.evidence: For charge state 2, MS2 scans were performed in the ion trap with rapid scan rate and CID fragmentation at 30% NCE, AGC target 4e3, and a max injection time of 250 ms.
MS2 scans were performed in the ion trap at a rapid scan rate following higher energy collision dissociation with a 35% normalized collision energy.

fragmentation_method.evidence: For charge state 2, MS2 scans were performed in the ion trap with rapid scan rate and CID fragmentation at 30% NCE, AGC target 4e3, and a max injection time of 250 ms.

For charge states 3–7 with a minimum intensity of 500 000, MS2 scans were performed in the Orbitrap at 7500 resolution with HCD fragmentation at 30% NCE, AGC target 5e4, and a max injection time of 22 ms.
